player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Mastermind.
You need to find the code that is {code_length} digits long, each digit from 1 to {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
In your response, you can submit your guess in the following format: '[2 1 4 5]'.
After each guess, you will receive feedback in the form of black and white pegs.
A black peg indicates a correct digit in the correct position, while a white peg indicates a correct digit in the wrong position.
You have {max_turns} turns to guess the code.
player_prompt.with_repeats: na lege ti kiringo ni peut-être.
player_prompt.no_duplicates: a yeke na atënë use pëpe

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mo kiri tënë pëpe na mbeni molongo ti a-nombre so ayeke nde, me mo zia ni na yâ akete kete gere.
invalid_move.not_integers: A lingbi a zia na yâ ni gi atâ wungo ti azo.
invalid_move.wrong_length: A lingbi a wara tâ gi {code_length} wungo ti azo so ayeke na yâ ni.
invalid_move.out_of_range: A lingbi wungo ni kue aduti na popo ti 1 nga {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.duplicates_not_allowed: A yeke yeda pëpe na adocteur ti kiri peko ti numero ni.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Mo hinga awe {guess}. Tara ti bâ mbeni ye nde na pekoni.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: You have cracked the code, solving {black_pegs} out of {code_length} pegs correctly
outcome.turn_limit: A si na ndo ti wungo so a lingbi mo zia ni. Mo hinga {percent} % ti adesizion nzoni.
